generate_api_docs_from_python_dir: generate API markdown documentation from docstrings in a Python source directory
convert_docstring_to_markdown: convert a Python docstring into formatted markdown with args and returns sections
process_python_file_for_docs: parse a Python file with AST and generate markdown docs for its classes and functions
write_api_table_of_contents: write a TOC.md file linking all generated API documentation markdown files
generate_docusaurus_header: generate a Docusaurus-style frontmatter header with an id field for a markdown page
